```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load needed packages

```{r load_packages}
gc()
library(gggenomes)
library(argparse)
library(gtools)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(ggeasy)
library(gridExtra)
```

## Set scale bar

```{r scale_bar, echo=FALSE}
scale_bar <- tibble(x = c(0), xend = c(50000000),
                    y = c(0), yend = c(0))

# Infer best units for scale bar
label <- paste(50000000, "bp", sep = " ")
if (50000000 %% 1e9 == 0) {
  label <- paste(50000000 / 1e9, "Gbp", sep = " ")
} else if (50000000 %% 1e6 == 0) {
  label <- paste(50000000 / 1e6, "Mbp", sep = " ")
} else if (50000000 %% 1e3 == 0) {
  label <- paste(50000000 / 1e3, "kbp", sep = " ")
}
```

# Chromosome 1

## Read the sequences

```{r load_synteny, echo=FALSE}
sequences <- read.csv("ntsynt_flatfish_chrom.sequence_lengths.tsv", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
```

## Prepare and rearrange the chromosome sequences

```{r prepare_rearrange, echo=FALSE}
## Set genome order
input_order <- unique(sequences$bin_id)

sequences <- sequences[sequences$seq_id == 'NC_081134.1' | sequences$seq_id == 'NC_058021.1' | sequences$seq_id == 'OY735178.1' | sequences$seq_id == 'OY735188.1', ]

## Set chromosome order
input_chrom_order <- c("OY735178.1", "OY735188.1", "NC_058021.1", "NC_081134.1")
mixedrank <- function(x) order(gtools::mixedorder(x))

## Rearrange line order to match wanted genome and chromosome orders
sequences <- sequences %>%
  arrange(factor(bin_id, levels=input_order),
          factor(seq_id, levels=input_chrom_order))

## Change bin_id names
sequences$bin_id[sequences$bin_id == "solSol_chrom.fa"] <- "Solea solea"
sequences$bin_id[sequences$bin_id == "solSen_chrom.fa"] <- "Solea senegalensis"
sequences$bin_id[sequences$bin_id == "micVar_chrom.fa"] <- "Microchirus variegatus"
```

## Read and prepare synteny links

```{r prepare_links, echo=FALSE}
links_ntsynt <- read.csv("ntsynt_flatfish_chrom.links.tsv",
                         sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
links_ntsynt$seq_id <- factor(links_ntsynt$seq_id,
                              levels = mixedsort(unique(links_ntsynt$seq_id)))
links_ntsynt <- links_ntsynt[mixedorder(links_ntsynt$seq_id), ]
links_ntsynt$seq_id2 <- as.character(links_ntsynt$seq_id2)
links_ntsynt$colour_block <- as.factor(links_ntsynt$colour_block)
links_ntsynt <- links_ntsynt[links_ntsynt$seq_id == 'NC_081134.1' & links_ntsynt$seq_id2 == 'NC_058021.1' | links_ntsynt$seq_id == 'NC_058021.1' & links_ntsynt$seq_id2 == 'OY735188.1' | links_ntsynt$seq_id == 'NC_058021.1' & links_ntsynt$seq_id2 == 'OY735178.1', ]
links_ntsynt$bin_id[links_ntsynt$bin_id == "solSol_chrom.fa"] <- "Solea solea"
links_ntsynt$bin_id2[links_ntsynt$bin_id2 == "solSen_chrom.fa"] <- "Solea senegalensis"
links_ntsynt$bin_id[links_ntsynt$bin_id == "solSen_chrom.fa"] <- "Solea senegalensis"
links_ntsynt$bin_id2[links_ntsynt$bin_id2 == "micVar_chrom.fa"] <- "Microchirus variegatus"
```

## Adapt chromosome names

```{r adapt_chr_names, echo=FALSE}
links_ntsynt <- links_ntsynt %>% mutate(colour_block = ifelse(seq_id2 == "NC_058021.1", "chrom01", colour_block))
links_ntsynt <- links_ntsynt %>% mutate(colour_block = ifelse(seq_id == "NC_058021.1", "chrom01", colour_block))
```

## Make the ribbon plot

```{r plot, echo=FALSE}
p <-  gggenomes(seqs = sequences, links = links_ntsynt)
plot1 <- p + theme_gggenomes_clean(base_size = 15) +
  geom_link(aes(fill = "#7ebacc", color = "#7ebacc"),
            offset = 0,
            alpha = 0.5,
            size = 0.05) +
  geom_seq(size = 1.5,
           colour = "gray31") +
  geom_seq_label(aes(label = c("5", "15", "LG1", "1")),
                 vjust = c(-2, -2, 0.5, 0.5),
                 hjust = c(-20, -7, -6, -22.5),
                 size = 10,
                 fontface = "bold",
                 show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_bin_label(aes(label = bin_id),
                 size = 10,
                 hjust = 0.9,
                 fontface = "bold.italic") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 25),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size=8),
        legend.key.size = unit(1,"line"),
        legend.title = element_text(size=12),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent'),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill='transparent', color=NA)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = "#7ebacc",
                    guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = "#7ebacc",
                      guide = "none") +
  ggtitle("Synteny plot of chromosome LG1") +
  easy_remove_x_axis(what = c("ticks", "title", "text", "line"), teach = FALSE)

## reverse some chromosomes to make the plot nicer
plot1 <- plot1 %>% flip_seqs(2)
plot1

# Save as high resolution figure
ggsave(paste("synteny_plot_flatfish_K1", ".png", sep = ""),
       plot1,
       units = "cm",
       widt = 50,
       height = 20,
       bg = "transparent",
       dpi = 300)
```

## Read the sequences


## Prepare and rearrange the chromosome sequences

```{r prepare_rearrange, echo=FALSE}
## Set genome order

sequences <- sequences[sequences$seq_id == 'NC_081135.1' | sequences$seq_id == 'NC_058022.1'  | sequences$seq_id == 'OY735178.1' | sequences$seq_id == 'OY735195.1' | sequences$seq_id == 'OY735174.1', ]

## Set chromosome order
input_chrom_order <- c("OY735195.1", "OY735178.1", "OY735174.1", "NC_058022.1", "NC_081135.1")
mixedrank <- function(x) order(gtools::mixedorder(x))

## Rearrange line order to match wanted genome and chromosome orders
sequences <- sequences %>%
  arrange(factor(bin_id, levels=input_order),
          factor(seq_id, levels=input_chrom_order))

## Change bin_id names
sequences$bin_id[sequences$bin_id == "solSol_chrom.fa"] <- "Solea solea"
sequences$bin_id[sequences$bin_id == "solSen_chrom.fa"] <- "Solea senegalensis"
sequences$bin_id[sequences$bin_id == "micVar_chrom.fa"] <- "Microchirus variegatus"
```

## Read and prepare synteny links

```{r prepare_links, echo=FALSE}
links_ntsynt <- read.csv("ntsynt_flatfish_chrom.links.tsv",
                         sep = "\t", header = TRUE)

links_ntsynt$seq_id2 <- as.character(links_ntsynt$seq_id2)
links_ntsynt$colour_block <- as.factor(links_ntsynt$colour_block)
links_ntsynt <- links_ntsynt[links_ntsynt$seq_id == 'NC_081135.1' & links_ntsynt$seq_id2 == 'NC_058022.1' | links_ntsynt$seq_id == 'NC_058022.1' & links_ntsynt$seq_id2 == 'OY735178.1' | links_ntsynt$seq_id == 'NC_058022.1' & links_ntsynt$seq_id2 == 'OY735195.1' | links_ntsynt$seq_id == 'NC_058022.1' & links_ntsynt$seq_id2 == 'OY735174.1', ]
links_ntsynt$bin_id[links_ntsynt$bin_id == "solSol_chrom.fa"] <- "Solea solea"
links_ntsynt$bin_id2[links_ntsynt$bin_id2 == "solSen_chrom.fa"] <- "Solea senegalensis"
links_ntsynt$bin_id[links_ntsynt$bin_id == "solSen_chrom.fa"] <- "Solea senegalensis"
```

## Adapt chromosome names

```{r adapt_chr_names, echo=FALSE}
links_ntsynt <- links_ntsynt %>% mutate(colour_block = ifelse(seq_id2 == "NC_058022.1", "chrom02", colour_block))
```

## Make the ribbon plot

```{r plot, echo=FALSE}
p <-  gggenomes(seqs = sequences, links = links_ntsynt)
plot2 <- p + theme_gggenomes_clean(base_size = 15) +
  geom_link(aes(fill = "#d84f31", color = "#d84f31"),

            alpha = 0.5,

  geom_seq(size = 1.5,
           colour = "gray31") +
  geom_seq_label(aes(label = c("22", "5", "1", "LG2", "2")),
                 vjust = c(-2, -2, -2, 0.5, 0.5),
                 hjust = c(-2.5, -10, -14, -2.5, -11),
                 size = 10,
                 fontface = "bold",
                 show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_bin_label(aes(label = bin_id),
                 size = 10,
                 hjust = 0.9,
                 fontface = "bold.italic") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 25),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size=8),
        legend.key.size = unit(1,"line"),
        legend.title = element_text(size=12),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent'),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill='transparent', color=NA)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = "#d84f31",
                    guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = "#d84f31",
                      guide = "none") +
  ggtitle("Synteny plot of chromosome LG2") +
  easy_remove_x_axis(what = c("ticks", "title", "text", "line"), teach = FALSE)

## reverse some chromosomes to make the plot nicer

# Save as high resolution figure
```
